messages:
Maya: Heads-up — enterprise request from ACME: they want per-tenant A/B experiments that can split traffic inside their Dedicated slice but still obey isolation quotas. Need API + console UX ideas.
Ethan: Do we mean splitting at the routing layer (pre-proxy) or at the request-router inside the shard? different failure modes.
Priya: Prefer routing layer so we can account for quota before hitting pool. Also keeps logs/telemetry cleaner for billing.
Noah: Routing-layer split has problems with tiny percentages and sticky sessions. We need deterministic assignment (hashing) and rounding rules.
Maya: Good point. ACME wants 0.5% -> 99.5% for a new variant. That should not cause bursts on rollout.
Jules: Proposal: expose an "experiment" object in API tied to tenant id + route with fields: traffic_split (map), isolation_profile (max_qps, reserved_slots), rollback_triggers (p95_latency_ms, error_rate_pct).
Ethan: Can we see a quick proto?
Jules: ```json
{
  "experiment_id": "acme-2026-02-ab1",
  "tenant_id": "acme",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "traffic_split": {"control": 0.995, "variant": 0.005},
  "assignment": {"algo": "fnv1a_hash", "key": "user_id"},
  "isolation_profile": {"max_qps": 1200, "reserved_capacity_pct": 10},
  "rollback_triggers": {"error_rate_pct": 1.0, "p95_latency_ms": 1000}
}
```
Priya: Love it. Two asks: 1) make assignment key optional (defaults to session/user) 2) ensure reserved_capacity_pct is minimum reserved slots, not just percentage math that can round to 0.
Noah: Also: we need smooth ramping logic. If variant is 0.5% but rollout grows to 5% over 30m, ensure token-bucket enforcement so downstream capacity isn't overloaded.
Maya: Console UX thought: show a per-tenant experiment card with live traffic slice, reserved vs used capacity, and a single-click rollback button that triggers immediate shift to control. Link to telemetry.
Ethan: For telemetry, we'd want synthetic metric names: experiment.{id}.traffic.{variant|control}.qps, .p95_ms, .err_pct — so alerts and dashboards can be templated.
Jules: ops-bot can emit experiment lifecycle events into #incidents for visibility?
ops-bot: auto:experiment_event acme-2026-02-ab1 created by Jules — reserved_capacity 10% of tenant pool applied.
Noah: Implementation detail debate: do we implement traffic split in the router (fastpath C code) or a filter we can hot-config? Router fastpath preferred for perf but harder to iterate.
Priya: Could do hybrid: router hash->bucket decision, but decision table pulled from config service so we can change splits without a full deploy. Router keeps a small in-memory table with versioned configs.
Ethan: Sounds reasonable. Also need to ensure logs include experiment_id on every span to link traces. That will let quality monitoring tie regressions to experiment.
Maya: Rollback triggers — micro question: should rollback be automatic or alert-only by default? ACME prefers auto with a cool-off and operator notification.
Jules: Default to alert-only, enterprise flag for auto-rollback. Auto-rollback flow: mark variant traffic to 0, promote to control, keep note for 7d.
Noah: Edge-case: what if variant caused high errors but only for specific customer segments (e.g., model prompt types)? Our monitoring needs prompt-set breakdowns. We should link experiments to eval prompt sets.
Priya: Agree. Add optional field: "eval_sets": ["smoke_v1","acme_key_prompts"] so Optimize and quality-monitoring can compute regression deltas.
Maya: UX for console: timeline of metric deltas, recommended action (pause/ramp/rollback), and quick link to create a support ticket. Keep it compact — PMs hate too many panels.
Ethan: API name debate: /v1/tenants/{t}/experiments vs /v1/experiments? I prefer nested under tenants to make auth simpler.
Jules: nested is simpler for RBAC. We can still support cross-tenant list for admins.
Maya: One last: quotas & billing. If reserved_capacity_pct is used, billing should reflect reserved GPU-hours during experiment window. Finance will want clarity.
Priya: We'll add metadata: billing_profile {"type":"reserved","units":"gpu_seconds","estimate_formula":"slots * window"} so finance has something to parse.
Ethan: deploy-bot pushed acl changes for experiments service to staging.
deploy-bot: deploy:experiments-service staging v0.84.2 started by Ethan — logs: https://ci/redwood/exp/123
Jules: I'll draft API spec and console mock tonight and post a follow-up. Can we get a quick review tomorrow morning? :thumbsup:
Maya: SGTM. Thanks everyone.
Noah: Minor follow-up: rounding rule for traffic_split — always convert to integer bucket over 10000, so 0.005 -> 50/10000. Avoid <1 bucket unless we explicitly allow sampling at request-level.
Priya: Noted. We'll add that to the spec.
ops-bot: auto:reminder "review experiment rollouts spec" scheduled for 1979999250 in #eng-platform
Maya: Closing for now — will watch the draft. """"""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""
